# foreman_katello_sync_plan (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_sync_plan" "daily" {
  name = "daily"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello sync plan to look up.

### Read-Only

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression
- `description` (String) Description of the sync plan
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the sync plan is enabled
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interval` (String) Sync interval
- `sync_date` (String) Sync date
